backend/main.mo: Actor defining storage-backed book, chapter, annotation, user preference, and attachment management with role‑based access control using OrderedMaps and external blob storage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking frontend export-flow fixes to affected files, components, and related requirement ID.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing responsibilities of major frontend components, hooks, utilities, and styling files.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell mounting the React app and loading the main module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes, authentication guard, and root layout with theme and language providers.
frontend/src/components/AnnotationsPanel: UI panel for listing, creating, editing, and deleting annotations for a chapter using query hooks and language‑aware toasts.
frontend/src/components/ChapterEditor.ts: Rich text chapter editor supporting auto-save, spell checking, analysis, text improvement, attachments, TTS, annotations, and PDF/DOCX export with detailed state handling.
frontend/src/components/ChapterList.tsx: Chapter list sidebar allowing users to create, select, and delete chapters with navigation and toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/EmptyState.tsx: Displays a centered empty-state message with an icon when no content is available.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer showing a copyright notice and link, using language translations.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Top navigation bar with theme switcher, language selector, and logout handling.
frontend/src/components/SynonymSearchFie: Synonym search field with speech recognition, fetching synonyms from synonim.net, and error handling.
frontend/src/components/TextToSpeechCont: Text‑to‑speech controls for playing chapter content with selectable voice and speed preferences.
frontend/src/components/UserProfileSetup: Dialog prompting the user to input and save their profile name with validation and toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/VoiceSearchField: Voice-based search input component using Web Speech API and backend mutation to check spoken words in chapter content.
frontend/src/components/WriterLayout.tsx: Empty file or placeholder for future writer layout component.
frontend/src/components/WritingAnalysisP: Panel that parses and displays writing analysis results with categorized sections and loading/close controls.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: Provides language state, translation function, and user language preference syncing with backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, login state, and stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks wrapping backend calls for user profiles, books, chapters, annotations, and other editor features.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, theme color variables for light/dark modes, and styling for the Quill rich‑text editor.
frontend/src/lib/exportError.ts: Provides a function to extract and sanitize user-friendly error messages from unknown errors.
frontend/src/lib/fileDownload.ts: Implements utilities for downloading binary data as files and sanitizing filenames.
frontend/src/lib/quillAttachments.ts: Utilities for handling Quill editor image attachments, including parsing, marking states, and generating placeholders.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a helper to merge class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app root with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/BookPage.tsx: Displays a selected book’s details and chapters list, with loading and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/BooksListPage.tsx: Manages listing, creating, editing, and deleting books with dialogs, profile checks, and backend interactions.
frontend/src/pages/ChapterPage.tsx: Renders a chapter editor with chapter list navigation and loading/empty states.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Implements the login screen with Internet Identity authentication, automatic redirects, and language selection.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS config enabling dark mode, specifying content paths, and extending theme with custom colors, container settings, shadows, radii, and keyframes.
project_state.json: JSON describing the project’s state, features, issues, and requirements for a secure document editor with image handling and PDF/DOCX export.
